description: {"time": 1783112238725, "blocks": [{"id": "j2el9ef4v", "data": {"text": "Don't Shoot! \u2014 a powerful statement from Dennis Muraguri's Matatu Woodcut Prints collection. The title is a direct plea against gun violence, a universal message that transcends borders. Muraguri's woodcut renders the words in bold, urgent lettering that leaves no room for ambiguity \u2014 a cry for peace carved in black and white. This piece stands apart from the matatu documentary series as an original woodcut composition rather than a reproduction of an existing livery. It represents Muraguri's voice as an artist and citizen, using his mastery of the woodcut medium to address issues that matter to him and his community. Don't Shoot! is an essential piece for collectors who want to own not just a document of Nairobi culture but a direct statement from the artist.
